sources.title: InsideEVs: Watch How Long It Takes To Charge A Mustang Mach-E From 0 To 100%
sources.notes: 2021 Mustang Mach-E Launch Edition AWD, Extended Range (98.8 kWh gross, 88 kWh usable), Electrify America DC fast charger, session from near 0 % to 100 %. SoC-to-kW table of 11 rows published in the article. Ambient temperature, preconditioning, charger rating and software version not stated (initial 2021 firmware, before the 21P22 high-SoC update).

sources.title: InsideEVs: Ford Mustang Mach-E fast charging analysis
sources.notes: Separate 2021 First Edition Extended Range AWD session (Electrify America, 0-100 %, initial firmware): peak 159 kW almost immediately, about 112 kW at 7-10 %, 106-107 kW at 11-27 %, 95-97 kW at 31-37 %, 76-80 kW at 40-77 %, about 12 kW above 80 %. Used only as a shape cross-check.

curves.notes: 2021 Launch Edition AWD ER on initial firmware (88 kWh usable pack, same 98.8 kWh gross NMC pack as the 2021 GT and California Route 1). Peak in this table is 145 kW at 5 %; the separate InsideEVs analysis of a second 2021 session saw 159 kW at the very start. Second source agrees on shape: 106-107 kW at 11-27 %, 95-97 kW at 31-37 %, 76-80 kW at 40-77 %, ~12 kW above 80 %.Test started near 0 % SoC on an Electrify America charger (rating not stated).
